user-temp.name: User temp files
user-temp.note: Temporary files left behind by programs. Files that are in use are skipped automatically.

win-temp.name: System temp files
win-temp.note: Temporary files left by Windows and installers. Usually needs administrator rights to delete.

wu-download.name: Windows Update download cache
wu-download.note: Update packages that are already installed. Deleting them does not affect the system; an update in progress will download again. Needs administrator rights.

delivery-opt.name: Delivery Optimization cache
delivery-opt.note: Cache used to share updates with other PCs on your network. Needs administrator rights.

thumbcache.name: Thumbnail cache
thumbcache.note: File Explorer's image preview cache. It is rebuilt automatically. Files in use are skipped.

inetcache.name: IE / system web cache
inetcache.note: Web cache used by system components.

crash-dumps.name: Crash dumps
crash-dumps.note: Memory snapshots saved when a program or Windows crashes. Only needed for troubleshooting.

memory-dmp.name: System memory dump
memory-dmp.note: Full memory snapshot saved after a blue screen, usually large. Needs administrator rights.

d3dscache.name: DirectX shader cache
d3dscache.note: Shader cache for games and graphics apps. It is rebuilt automatically; the first launch may be a little slower.

gpu-cache.name: Graphics driver cache
gpu-cache.note: Shader cache of the graphics driver. It is rebuilt automatically.

recycle-bin.name: Recycle Bin
recycle-bin.note: After emptying, files in the Recycle Bin can no longer be restored.

windows-old.name: Previous Windows installation
windows-old.note: The old version kept after a Windows upgrade. After deleting it you can no longer roll back.
windows-old.alt: This folder has special permissions. Delete it in Settings → System → Storage → Temporary files by ticking “Previous Windows installation(s)”.

wu-relocated.name: Windows Update temp downloads (other drive)
wu-relocated.note: When the system drive is low on space, Windows Update temporarily stores downloads in this folder on another drive. Safe to clean after updates are installed; do not delete during an update.

do-relocated.name: Delivery Optimization cache (other drive)
do-relocated.note: The Delivery Optimization cache has been moved to this drive. Deleting it does not affect the system; it is downloaded again when needed.

chrome-cache.name: Chrome cache
chrome-cache.note: Web cache. Pages may load a little slower the first time afterwards. Close Chrome first.

edge-cache.name: Edge cache
edge-cache.note: Web cache. Pages may load a little slower the first time afterwards. Close Edge first.

browser-profile.name: Browser user data
browser-profile.note: Contains bookmarks, saved passwords, history and extensions. Deleting it loses all of these.

npm-cache.name: npm cache
npm-cache.note: Packages downloaded by npm. They are downloaded again when needed.

yarn-cache.name: Yarn cache
yarn-cache.note: Packages downloaded by Yarn. They are downloaded again when needed.

pnpm-store.name: pnpm store
pnpm-store.note: Package store shared by all pnpm projects. After deleting it, each project needs pnpm install again.

pip-cache.name: pip cache
pip-cache.note: Packages downloaded by pip. They are downloaded again when needed.

uv-cache.name: uv cache
uv-cache.note: Python packages downloaded by uv. They are downloaded again when needed.

conda-pkgs.name: Conda package cache
conda-pkgs.note: Conda package cache. Existing environments are not affected, but conda clean --all is the safer way to clean it.

gradle-cache.name: Gradle cache
gradle-cache.note: Gradle dependency cache. The next build downloads it again, which can take a while.

maven-repo.name: Maven local repository
maven-repo.note: Maven dependency cache. The next build downloads it again.

nuget-cache.name: NuGet package cache
nuget-cache.note: .NET dependency cache. The next build downloads it again.

cargo-cache.name: Cargo download cache
cargo-cache.note: Archives of Rust dependencies. They are downloaded again when needed.

jetbrains-cache.name: JetBrains IDE caches
jetbrains-cache.note: IDE index caches. Projects are re-indexed the next time you open them.

vscode-cache.name: VS Code cache
vscode-cache.note: VS Code caches, rebuilt automatically. Close VS Code first.

node-modules.name: node_modules folder
node-modules.note: Project dependencies. Run npm install in the project again after deleting.

pycache.name: Python bytecode cache
pycache.note: Generated by Python automatically and rebuilt when needed.

wechat-cache.name: WeChat cache
wechat-cache.note: WeChat temporary cache and logs. Deleting them does not affect chat history. Quit WeChat first.

wechat-media.name: WeChat images / videos / files
wechat-media.note: Images, videos and files sent and received in chats. After deleting, WeChat shows them as expired or unavailable.

wechat-data.name: WeChat account data
wechat-data.note: Contains the chat history database. Deleting it loses your chat history.

qq-media.name: QQ images / videos / files
qq-media.note: Images, videos and files sent and received in QQ chats. They can no longer be opened in QQ after deleting.

qq-data.name: QQ account data
qq-data.note: Contains the chat history database. Deleting it loses your chat history.

feishu-cache.name: Feishu / Lark cache
feishu-cache.note: Feishu client UI cache, rebuilt automatically. Quit Feishu first.

dingtalk-cache.name: DingTalk cache (not verified on this PC)
dingtalk-cache.note: DingTalk resource cache and logs. Quit DingTalk first.

dingtalk-media.name: DingTalk chat images (not verified on this PC)
dingtalk-media.note: Image cache from chats. Some images will need to load again after deleting.

steam-cache.name: Steam download and shader cache
steam-cache.note: Unfinished downloads and shader cache. Unfinished downloads will have to start over.

adobe-media-cache.name: Adobe media cache
adobe-media-cache.note: Preview cache of Premiere / After Effects, rebuilt automatically.

downloads.name: Downloads
downloads.note: Files you downloaded. Make sure you no longer need them before deleting.

personal.name: Personal files
personal.note: Your personal files (documents, photos, videos, etc.). Make sure they are backed up before deleting.

onedrive.name: OneDrive folder
onedrive.note: Cloud-synced folder. Deleting files here also deletes them in the cloud.

appdata.name: App data
appdata.note: App settings, sign-in state and data. Deleting it directly may make apps ask you to sign in again, lose settings or fail to start.

program-files.name: Installed programs
program-files.note: Program files of installed software. Deleting them breaks the software and it can no longer be uninstalled properly.
program-files.alt: Uninstall software in Settings → Apps → Installed apps instead.

program-data.name: Shared app data
program-data.note: Software data and settings shared by all users. Deleting it directly may stop software from running.
